operations.title: The paired half-rotation is an integral Gaussian norm-two correspondence
operations.statement: The canonical polarization exchange J on a perfect regular coefficient-Betti fiber satisfies J^2=-1. K=1+J is integral with K^2=2J, K-dagger K=2, per-mode Smith form (1,2), and cokernel Z/2. Its real unitary normalization K/sqrt(2)=exp(pi J/4) is the metaplectic half-rotation. Thus the endpoint is the primitive Gaussian factor 1+i of norm 2, not an arbitrary fitted path; physical chain realization and determinant xi remain unproved.
operations.scope: Exact integral paired correspondence; no physical boundary map, self-adjoint domain, xi determinant, or zero spectrum.

operations.title: Gaussian half-rotation correspondence test
operations.procedure: Compute J^2, the adjoint of J under the paired positive metric, K^2, K-dagger K, determinant, Smith form, and normalized real rotation.
operations.expected_result: K has norm and determinant two per mode, cokernel Z/2, and normalization exp(pi J/4). Any different invariant factor or rotation falsifies the claim.
